items.title: Nancy Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I did a song with the Brazilian. Ivan Lins. ... I Wish I’d Met You. I love that. That’s from the Turned to Blue.

ctx.x: Ivan Lins. What was that song? I can’t remember. What is the second song I do in my show now? I Wish I’d Met You. Whew. Getting ready to really lose it there for a minute. I Wish I’d Met You. I love that. That’s from the Turned to Blue.
Also on Turned to Blue is the title track. Tell us about that.

items.title: Nancy Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I did a song with the Brazilian.

ctx.x: That’s one of my favorites, Why Did I Chose You? And the other one from – oh dear. I did a song with the Brazilian.
